newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Burundi military ruler meets mediator Nyerere.
newsitem.headline: Burundi military ruler meets mediator Nyerere.

text.p: Burundi's military ruler Pierre Buyoya flew to northern Tanzania on Monday for talks with Julius Nyerere, the internationally backed mediator on Burundi.
An official at Nyerere's South Centre in the Tanzanian capital Dar es Salaam said Buyoya and Nyerere met in the northern town of Arusha but had no details of their talks.
Nyerere, a former Tanzanian president, has been pushing for Buyoya, who seized power in a coup by the Tutsi-dominated army last July, and Hutu rebels to open talks to end civil war.
Regional countries clamped economic and diplomatic sanctions on Burundi last July 31, six days after the army took power.
Burundi's isolated military regime began a "national debate" last week, declaring it was a first step to peace, but political leaders of the Hutu majority and Tutsi hardliners boycotted it.
The tiny country's ethnic civil war, which has claimed more than 150,000 lives since 1993, has raged on since the coup.
Hutu rebels led by Leonard Nyangoma's Forces for the Defence of Democracy are waging a hit-and-run war in much of the countryside against the army. Civilians are the main casualties.
